question: What is the value of x, if (5 + 4²) ÷ 3 of x – 2 × 4 = –7?
solution:
Concept Used: 

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

Calculation:

(5 + 42) ÷ 3 of x – 2 × 4 = –7

⇒ (5 + 16) ÷ 3 of x – 2 × 4 = -7

⇒ 21 ÷ 3 of x – 2 × 4 = -7

⇒ 21 ÷ 3x – 2 × 4 = -7

⇒ 21 × 1/3x – 2 × 4 = -7

⇒ 7/x – 2 × 4 = -7

⇒ 7/x – 8 = -7

⇒ 7/x = -7 + 8

⇒ 7/x = 1

⇒ x = 7

**∴ The required value of x is 7**
